current_episode.title: We fold our phones and get roasted by Leslie Jones

guest.bio_context: Leslie Jones was a basketball player at Colorado State University before launching her stand-up career after winning a funniest person on campus competition. She was personally recommended to Saturday Night Live by Chris Rock, where she became a huge star. She is currently hosting the show Roast My Rental on HGTV and is undertaking a new national stand-up tour.
